messages:
Priya Sharma: Quick request — we need a compact visual playbook for the upcoming webinar and launch posts. Goal: 1) one infographic that explains 'inference economics' flow, 2) 3 social-sized microcards, 3) a canonical slide that teams can reuse for sales demos. Due: EOD next Thurs.
Ava Chen: got it. do you have a preferred visual metaphor? pipeline, factory, or subway map?
Priya Sharma: thinking a simplified routemap (nodes for model, routing, cache, batching, fallback) — flows should show latency vs cost tradeoffs. keep brand colors, but make it work at thumb size.
Noah Rivera: I can draft short copy for each node. Keep labels short: "Model", "Route", "Batch/Cache", "Quantize", "Fallback" — then one-line blurbs.
Lucas Park: also need an assets routing hint for inbound: which CTA + landing to use for each card. For webinars we should include a single UTM'd link.
Ava Chen: ok — deliverables checklist:
- 1x A3 infographic (master .fig + pdf) with routemap + 3 annotations
- 3x 1080x1080 microcards (png + fig variants) with alt copy variations
- 1x 16:9 slide (editable, with notes for sales)
- 1x export pack with social-safe crops and accessibility alt text
Ava Chen: technical constraints: max 4 colors (brand primary + 3 accents), font: Redwood Sans, line weights scaled for 72px legibility.
Priya Sharma: include a small 'how to read' legend for non-technical PMs. Also add a 1-sentence tooltip for each node used in the slide notes.
Noah Rivera: draft copy for node blurbs (initial):
- Model — "Choice of model drives quality & token cost."
- Route — "Smart routing balances latency & unit price."
- Batch/Cache — "Batching and prefix cache reduce per-token cost."
- Quantize — "Lower-precision variants cut GPU memory and cost."
- Fallback — "Graceful downgrade to compatible model keeps availability."
Ava Chen: nice. I'll mock two layout directions and post Figma link by tomorrow lunchtime.
Lucas Park: tagging growth — @growth-team make sure tracking is set: use utm_campaign=llm-routemap & utm_source=social. Also route microcards to a short landing that A/B tests lead magnet copy.
DesignBot: Asset template generated: /figma/marketing/llm-routemap-template (auto-created). Ava: you own the file.
Ava Chen: thanks. question: do we need legal review for the wording 'cost savings up to X%'?
Priya Sharma: not for the routemap. If anyone wants to include explicit numbers we will need sign-off. Keep it qualitative for now.
Noah Rivera: noted — will avoid hard percent claims.
Ava Chen: timeline estimate: mockups tomorrow, first round visuals Wed, final pack Thu EOD. Any blockers?
Priya Sharma: no blockers from PM side. Lucas — can you confirm landing & tracking by Wed EOD?
Lucas Park: yep — will provision landing + tracking and share link by Wed 6pm PST.
Ava Chen: perfect. I'll add label layers for accessibility and export settings in the fig.
Priya Sharma: awesome — thanks team. Please keep comments inline in the Figma file. :thumbsup:
Noah Rivera: I'll add alt text drafts in the fig notes.
DesignBot: Reminder: weekly creative review scheduled Fri 9am — add to agenda if you want rapid feedback.
